speakers.name: Rosa Delgado
speakers.title: Principal Engineer
speakers.bio: Rosa has spent eleven years inside a freight routing system that predates her career and will outlast it. She writes about incremental migration and refuses to use the word 'rewrite'.
speakers.storyNote: STORYLINE: double-booked. She is the primary on the COBOL talk and a co-speaker on the observability talk, and both land in overlapping slots on day 1.

speakers.name: Kwame Asante
speakers.title: Staff SRE
speakers.bio: Kwame runs reliability for a platform that cannot go down during tax season. He believes most alerting is theatre and has the graphs to prove it.
speakers.storyNote: STORYLINE: missing headshot. First person the organizer chases in the comms demo.

speakers.name: Hana Kobayashi
speakers.title: Platform Lead
speakers.bio: Hana rebuilt on-call at a hospital system where a pager going unanswered is not a metrics problem. She is unreasonably calm.
speakers.storyNote: STORYLINE: missing slides AND release. The most-outstanding speaker on the dashboard.

speakers.name: Dmitri Volkov
speakers.title: Principal Architect
speakers.storyNote: STORYLINE: accepted with an empty bio. Shows the portal nudging someone to write one.

speakers.name: Amara Nwosu
speakers.title: Engineering Manager
speakers.bio: Amara runs incident review for a fleet operations team and has opinions about blameless postmortems that are more blameless in theory than practice.

speakers.name: Sean Brennan
speakers.title: Staff Engineer
speakers.bio: Sean writes tests for code that has no tests, which he describes as archaeology with a deadline.
speakers.storyNote: STORYLINE: missing recording release. His session is in the recorded room, so this one actually blocks something.

speakers.name: Priyanka Rao
speakers.title: Director of Engineering
speakers.bio: Priyanka has migrated three companies between data warehouses and would like to stop being the person who does that.

speakers.name: Tobias Lindqvist
speakers.title: Systems Engineer
speakers.bio: Tobias cut a forty-minute build to four and has been dining out on it ever since. Deservedly.
speakers.storyNote: STORYLINE: the late-slides persona. Missing headshot and slides two weeks out.

speakers.name: Mei-Lin Chen
speakers.title: Tech Lead
speakers.bio: Mei-Lin wrote her company's deprecation policy after an internal API vanished mid-quarter and took a claims pipeline with it.

speakers.name: Jamal Carter
speakers.title: DevOps Lead
speakers.bio: Jamal onboards engineers onto a codebase older than most of them and has turned it into a repeatable process.

speakers.name: Sofia Marchetti
speakers.title: Principal Designer
speakers.bio: Sofia designs internal tools nobody chose to use and everybody has to.

speakers.name: Gwen Okonkwo
speakers.title: VP Engineering
speakers.bio: Gwen has run engineering at Sable Payments since the ledger was a single Postgres box. It is still, in her words, mostly a single Postgres box.
speakers.storyNote: STORYLINE: sponsor keynote speaker. Never submitted to the CFP — added directly by the organizer.
